what: piece of cha chaan teng dishwashing equipment
scale: One scale for all, the same as the board's counters (the prep counter there is about 1.5 m long and waist-high).

items.name: sink
items.look: a double-basin stainless steel sink unit about 1.6 m long and waist-high with a drainboard at one end, a tall gooseneck tap and a spray hose on a spring arm, a steel undershelf below; its long front faces down-left

items.name: dish_rack
items.look: a free-standing stainless steel rack shelf about 1 m long and 1.6 m tall, its shelves stacked with clean white plates, bowls and cups; its long front faces down-left

items.name: bus_trolley
items.look: a small two-tier steel trolley on castors carrying a grey plastic bus tub full of dirty plates, bowls and cups with a few chopsticks; its long side faces down-left

items.name: crate_stack
items.look: a stack of two blue plastic dish crates, the top one holding clean white bowls, on the floor; long sides facing down-left
